112: "The honor of the Torah ceased" - that he (Rabbi Akiva) would draw out meaning from every jot and tittle of every letter, and all the more so from superfluous words and letters, like "I derive it [from the fact that the verse could have stated:] “The daughter [of a priest,” but instead states:] “And the daughter [of a priest] (Leviticus 21:9)." (Sanhedrin 51b)
